To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
HIV-1 genotypes can be detected in 98% samples with HIV- 1 RNA<1.000 copies/ml, when the NucliSENS extraction is combined with the ViroSeq HIV genotyping system.

the NeM system combined with the ViroSeq assay was associated with high performances in detecting HIV-1 drug-resistances in samples with HIV RNA levels <1,000 copies/ml, thus improving patient management.

the NeM extraction method is able to extract HIV-1 RNA in samples with viral load < 1,000 HIV-1 RNA copies/mL, and that this method is associated with a high success rate in HIV-1 drug-resistances genotyping.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a new magnetic-silica based method of nucleic acid extraction, the NucliSENS® easyMAG (hereafter NeM).
the development of new methods for the detection of HIV-1 resistance to antiretroviral drugs.
the use of magnetic-silica based extraction for HIV-1 drug-resistence testing in low viraemic patients.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the NeM is an efficient method for extracting HIV-1 RNA from plasma, and that it is a good method for use with the ViroSeq assay.
HIV-1 genotypes are more likely to be obtained from samples with low HIV-1 RNA concentrations when the extraction procedure uses the magnetic-silica based extraction system NeM.
HIV-1 drug-resistances can be detected with a high success rate by direct sequencing of the HIV-1 pol-gene, using the NucliSENS EasyMAG system for nucleic acid extraction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
NeM is a reliable and easy to use extraction method that allows the successful detection of drug resistance mutations in HIV-1 RNA samples with viral load < 1,000 c/mL.
we have developed a new magnetic-silica based extraction method for HIV-1 nucleic acids, which can improve the performances of HIV- 1 genotyping in low viremia samples.
NeM is an efficient extraction system for HIV-1 RNA detection and genotyping.
The main takeaway from our work is that
NeM can be used to extract HIV-1 from low viral load specimens.
NeM is a very efficient extraction method for HIV-1 drug-resisance testing in samples with HIV RNA levels <1000 copies/mL.
NeM is a high-recovery and high purity extraction method that can enhance the performances of HIV- 1 genotyping assays.
